description: Congestion management activations - Countertrading - data up to 22/05/2024 is a dataset listed in Elia open data platform, an open data platform of a transmission system operator, published or maintained by Elia Group. Countertrading congestion management activations performed by Elia.Congestion management activations:- Internal Redispatching: All redispatching bids are performed in the control area where the congestion is located.- Cross-Border Redispatching: The redispatching bids are performed in different control areas.- Countertrading: Cross zonal exchange initiated by system operators between two bidding zones to relieve physical congestion.﻿This dataset contains data ... Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Congestion management. Its keywords are Activations, EU Reg. No 534/2013. The portal shows 2025-06-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Elia Open Data Licence (/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-elia-open-data-portal.
